title: A Fairness Audit of the Duckworth–Lewis–Stern Method: Format-Specific and Gender-Differential Bias, with an Interpretable Calibration Layer for Cricket Target Revision
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the fairness and potential gender bias of the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method used in cricket. It does not contain any components evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
